answer: One concrete sybil defense is randomized physical-checkpoint presence. Each agent carries a single-use signal to a randomly chosen, geographically scattered kiosk within a tight window; the kiosk returns a location-bound attestation signed by a tamper-evident violet crystal. Replaying a spent nonce is rejected, so cloning an identity means appearing at many distant checkpoints simultaneously—prohibitively costly for a farm. Bonds are slashed on any reused or forged token.
